description: Ask-path fixture bench through the Messages API planner (AGT-01, tier real_agent): the object workspace's Ask (operator_ui.object_workspace.ObjectWorkspace.ask_run, operating.agent_loop.run unchanged: the reader's read-only ontology tools, its bounds, the evidence rule and the claim gate) with operating.messages_planner.MessagesPlanner as its planner (native tool use, prompt caching of the system prompt and tool schemas, streaming; the opt-in planner of operator_ui.case_console --ask when PLX_ASK_PLANNER is messages) over the pinned 10-item FIXTURE_SAMPLE of evals/dev on the fixture world, scored by evals/score.py as eval.ask_agent scores it. Measures latency and cost per Ask: eval.total.ask.planner (requests, failed requests, per-Ask latency mean / p50 / max, request p50 / p95, time to the first streamed event, input / cache-write / cache-read / output tokens, the cache-read share of the input, and cost per Ask in the currency of PLX_MESSAGES_PRICES as Decimal strings; cost null with cost_basis price_setting_absent without prices). Counts, rates and enums only; transcripts stay in {tmp}.
notes: live-unverified until a passing live-check result; no Messages API answer is recorded until this check runs. Opt-in, owner-supplied: it spends the API key's account (decision docs/decisions/messages-api-planner-q7.md: opt-in under a named service key, Claude Code the default and the fallback, no automatic paid fallback; GOV-17 stands). The key settings are declared in optional_env, not requires_env, so the guard passes whichever one is set and an absent key reads blocked rather than skipped, so the check never skips silently: without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or PLX_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY the command reports agent_unmeasured credentials_absent, without PLX_MESSAGES_MODEL model_setting_absent (no model is built in), agent_settings naming the settings (names only) and the check is blocked (later_ask), before any session. No session answered (every_session_failed) is blocked host_misconfiguration. Keyless tests (operating/tests/test_messages_planner.py) run this command with no settings (blocked credentials_absent naming both key settings) and with an injected Messages planner over a fake streamed transport (the planner block of the summary meets this expect's json_fields; tool calls round-trip, cache markers, bounds, the claim gate). Budget: at most 10 sessions (k=1), each at most 8 planner requests of at most 120 s inside 300 s (later requests escalate session_time_exhausted), all started inside 540 s: 840 s with one overrun, under the 900 s timeout. Sizing (2026-10-21): this check has never run (it was deferred for budget at 3600 s); the same 10 fixture items through eval.ask_agent's Claude Code planner took 228-427 s whole in the published results, so the timeout is about 2x that (a proxy, re-size from the first Messages run); a session the budget refuses is blocked and the run incomplete, never a pass. B1 bar as eval.ask_agent: accuracy >= 0.8, coverage >= 0.8, confident_unsupported_rate <= 0.02. Cost is a measurement, never asserted: PLX_MESSAGES_PRICES ({input, cache_write, cache_read, output} per million tokens and an ISO 4217 currency) gives it; without it cost is null (price_setting_absent). Daily at most.
